summary: DHCPv4 already has a Leasequery feature for asking about one address binding at a time. That is inefficient or impractical in some cases. This standards-track RFC adds an active mode, where a requestor can ask a DHCP server for bulk binding information and keep receiving updates as bindings change. It updates RFC 6926.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking the office clerk about one visitor at a time, you get the whole guest list and the clerk keeps telling you whenever someone arrives or leaves.

questions: how to get dhcp lease updates in bulk
